title: In the Aliro access control reference applications of the Nordic Semiconductor nRF Door Lock and Access Control Add-on…
description: A vulnerability exists in the Aliro access control reference applications of the Nordic Semiconductor nRF Door Lock and Access Control Add-on versions 1.0.0 through 1.1.1. When configured with Credential Issuer CA certificate-based issuer trust and the Aliro Step-up phase enabled, the system incorrectly treats a failed lookup of the Credential Issuer as success, skipping a critical credential rollback check. This allows a former authorized user with an old but validly signed Access Document to gain physical access even after their credential has been revoked. The issue is fixed in version 1.2.0.
